title: Distinct Track Stream
description: A streaming service wants to find the length of the longest continuous sequence of music tracks played by a user without any track being repeated. Given a string representing the sequence of track IDs played, return the length of the longest substring that contains no duplicate tracks.
constraints: s consists of English letters, digits, symbols and spaces.
input_format: A string s representing the track stream.
output_format: An integer representing the length of the longest unique track segment.

examples.explanation: The answer is "abc", with the length of 3.
The answer is "b", with the length of 1.
The answer is "wke", with the length of 3. Notice that the answer must be a substring, "pwke" is a subsequence and not a substring.
